documentation_scope: README, user/build/CLI/architecture/privacy/accessibility/PDF-A guides, changelog, contribution/security/support/code-of-conduct/data attribution, publication process, CI and issue/PR templates.

github_ci.result: Consult GitHub Actions for the current commit; local verification does not assert a hosted-run result.

historical_release_evidence: Existing3.6 manifests describe their original artifacts and are not re-attributed to the documentation preparation commit.
remaining_release_steps: Owner may explicitly change visibility later and configure protections/security reporting available for the account. Source publication does not publish/notarize a binary.

compiler_compatibility_change.reason: Xcode16.4 rejects conversion of PDFStructureError into CFError in the signing failure path.
compiler_compatibility_change.fix: Throw the native CFError when provided; otherwise throw the separate PDFStructureError.security fallback.

fixture_compiler_compatibility.reason: Older compiler timed out on overloaded Data concatenations; replace with linear append preserving byte sequence. Recent SDK needed to expose SecIdentityCreate used only in memory-only cryptographic fixtures.

cross_macos_portability.resource_discovery: Flat and Contents/Resources bundle layouts, XCTest sibling product directories; test runner supplies exact SwiftPM product bundle. Missing installations never call fatal Bundle.module or search cwd/app siblings.
cross_macos_portability.link_ownership: Standard /NM assigned when creating link annotations, including keyboard creation, with saved COS, reopen/remove/undo assertions.
cross_macos_portability.choice_fields: Verify saved /V and /Opt using independent CoreGraphics reads; preserve exact export values, labels and immutable input, rather than OS-dependent PDFKit convenience getter.
cross_macos_portability.packaged_release_smoke: scripts/check-built-app.py validates real packaged resource hashes and CLI output for all11profiles; synthetic document without XMP must be nonconforming, never certified.
